emojis.label: pope leo surgery recovery
emojis.title: As Pope Leo Recovers From Surgery, Messages of Support Abound at Rome Hospital
emojis.summary: The pontiff, 71, is expected to spend about a week in the hospital recovering from surgery that found lung cancer. Messages of support have flooded in from far and wide.

emojis.label: turkey raids opposition tv
emojis.title: Turkey Raids Pro-Opposition TV Station
emojis.summary: The government appointed an overseer to the last big news channel critical of President Recep Tayyip Erdogan. The authorities have now replaced the leadership at five major news outlets.

emojis.label: australia's first michelin stars
emojis.title: Australia's first-ever Michelin stars go to 11 restaurants in one state
emojis.summary: All of the spots are in South Australia, reportedly because the state government paid for incognito inspectors to visit.

emojis.label: indian police brutality protests
emojis.title: Indian Protesters Describe Rough Treatment by the Police
emojis.summary: Some of those detained accused security forces of beating them during an intense crackdown on demonstrations in India’s capital over the weekend. Police have said they followed the law.
